name: Circle of the Sun (Druid Circle)
body:
You see truth in the pure and burning light of the sun, and can call upon its blessing or wrath to work great deeds.

Bonus Spells: sun metal (1st), blinding ray (2nd). heatstroke (3rd), burst with light (4th), flame strike (5th), chains of light (6th), sunbeam (7th), sunburst (8th), fiery body (9th).

Manifestation: You have a constant tan as if you had spent time in the sun. When exposed to direct sunlight, your eyes have a prismatic sheen like a prism or soap bubble.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Miniature Sun (Su)

As a standard action, you may summon your miniature sun: a ball of brilliant flames the size of your hand. The ball floats in the air (or underwater) near you and moves where you direct it. The ball has a speed of 60 and always remains within 30 feet of you, or else it immediately returns to that range.

In addition to providing light equal to a light spell, you may order your light to set fire to unattended objects, or to impact creatures. In the latter case, the sun does 1d6 damage per class level, with a Reflex saving throw vs a DC equal to 10 + half your class level + your Wisdom modifier being able to negate the damage. This is a standard action, separate from summoning the sphere.

You may dismiss your sun as a standard action. You may only have one sun at a time. The sun is incorporeal, but can be extinguished by darkness or cold spell effect with a level equal to or greater than twice your class level.

At 8th level, your sun can act as the source for any spells you cast with the fire or light descriptor. It may also deliver your touch spells with either of those descriptors.

At 16th level, your sun acts as natural sunlight against creatures vulnerable to it.

Too Close to the Sun (Su)

At 8th level, you accumulate the heat of the sun. You are considered charged with solar energy while you are standing in direct sunlight and for 1 minute thereafter. While charged with solar energy you may direct this heat to harm any creature attacking you in melee, with the exception of reach weapons, or delivering melee touch spells. Such attacking creatures are dealt fire damage 2d6 fire damage automatically. At 16th level, this becomes 4d6.

Creatures that are grappling or being grappled by you take maximum damage.

Additionally, anytime you cast a spell with the fire or light descriptor you can temporarily charge yourself with solar energy. You remain charged for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell + 1.

Harsh Light of Day (Su)

At 16th level, any spell or effect that has the shadow descriptor, creates fog or precipitation, renders a creature invisible or that creates a darkness effect is suppressed as if you had a 10-foot-radius antimagic field centered on and moving with you. Such spells are not dispelled and their duration continues to expire while within the area of this field. Such spells cannot be cast within this radius or targeting you. You may activate or deactivate this ability as a free action.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Drive Away the Darkness (Sp)

(Major Talent)

Once per round as a free action you may attempt to dispel a spell or effect with the shadow or cold descriptor or a spell or effect that creates a darkness effect as if using the dispel magic spell. Alternatively, you may instead banish a creature native to the shadow plane back to their home as if using the spell dismissal as a standard action.

Healing Light (Sp)

(Major Talent)

You place your hands on another creature, and cause them to regain hit points up to half your current hit point total. You lose the same number of hit points.

Shaded Against the Sun (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You are immune to the dazzled condition and gain a +4 bonus on saves vs, effects or spells that cause the blinded condition or that have the light or fire descriptor. You cannot be blinded by bright light.

Tempered in the Flame (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You gain fire resistance equal to twice your class level. At 16th level, this becomes fire immunity.
